title: Clean Air, Water Bodies, Environmental Accountability and Single-Use Plastic Prohibition Bill
source_or_instruction: Public-interest Union-law proposal concerning clean air, safe water, single-use plastic prohibition, pollution/disposal controls, accountable public duties, restoration, transparent monitoring and constitutionally bounded enforcement safeguards.
notes: Matter 008 is the continuing record for this consolidated Bill. The prior short draft and supporting artefacts are preserved with legacy-pre-research names. The current operative draft is 01-draft/not-ready-for-introduction.md; it is not introduction-ready and is not eligible for registry entry. Former Matter 030 was consolidated here on 2026-08-10 because it covered the same instrument.
